value.rationale: Anisotropic conductances are intrinsic to physical diffusion and finite-volume graph generators. A global all-step, nonreentrant positivity interval computable solely from local weighted edges and three-path sums gives sharp decisions beyond universal forward-Euler restrictions. The two mechanisms genuinely change with conductance ratios, shown by four-vertex examples.
